messages:
Mia_CS: hey team — quick heads up, Olivia flagged intermittent tail latency spikes for NovaCare's chat endpoint after they bumped context to ~512. thought we should propose a short pilot to avoid renewal friction. :wave:
Olivia_PMT: yea noticed it during the demo last night. 95th ~180ms but p99 jumps to ~1.9s and a couple of timeouts. happens around 200–300 tokens. logs show some KV cache cold misses.
Mia_CS: setup: hosted, model=open-xlarge-v1, no quant, routing=region-first, EU-West traffic bursty. cc @Raj_Infra for infra feasibility.
Raj_Infra: can you paste a perf sample and their p50/p95/p99 windows? also whether these are single-shot or multi-turn sessions.
Olivia_PMT: single-turn mostly, occasional follow-ups. sample: p50 60ms, p95 180ms, p99 1900ms. repro on staging.
Mia_CS: my proposal (lightweight, reversible):
1) enable prefix prefetching / aggressive KV warmup for session starters (reduces cold-miss penalty)
2) introduce a hybrid fallback: short-paths continue hitting open-xlarge, long contexts (>256) fall back to compact-v2 for token generation
3) trial INT8 "balanced" quant profile on a small dedicated slot during off-peak to cut token cost and smooth latency
4) pin account routing to nearest dedicated eu pool during canary (no global fallthrough)
Sam_SE: add adaptive batching with a short latency cap (SLO 300ms) so short requests get batched aggressively. also we'll run a quality eval on the fallback model to watch for regressions.
Raj_Infra: technical snippet for canary config:
```
enable_prefix_cache: true
prefix_cache_ttl: 300s
fallback_model: compact-v2@2026-03
quant_profile: int8-balanced
route_policy: account-dedicated-eu (no-fallback-global)
batching: adaptive, latency_cap_ms: 300
canary_window: 2h
```
OpsBot: Canary task created: nova-canary-prefetch-2026-03-25T02:00Z, owners: Raj_Infra, Sam_SE, window: 2h. Monitoring: token_latency, kv_hit_rate, hallucination_rate.
Olivia_PMT: can we start on staging keys first? prefer to see quality metrics before any production routing changes.
Mia_CS: absolutely — plan is: staging canary -> evaluate token-level latency & eval set -> if stable, run short production canary with traffic slice. Sam will own evals.
Sam_SE: I'll build a 40-sample eval focusing on long-context Q&A, reranking, and multi-turn coherence. will include acceptance thresholds for latency and top-1 accuracy. aiming to have it EOD tomorrow.
Raj_Infra: I'll reserve a 2-GPU dedicated slot in EU-West for the canary and enable the quant profile on that slot; will collect traces, kv hit rates, and cold-start counts.
Mia_CS: perfect. next actions: Sam produce eval set, Raj schedule canary and share dashboard link, Olivia confirm staging creds. ping this thread with green/red status. :thumbsup:
